layout.body:
Dear Student Council,
Our school has been invited to participate in the annual City Clean-Up Day on May 5th. We need 50 student volunteers to help clean Riverside Park from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
Volunteers will receive:
• Community service hours
• Free lunch
• A commemorative t-shirt
There will be a sign-up meeting this Thursday at lunch in Room 201. If you can't attend but want to help, email Mr. Davis by Friday. This is a great chance to represent our school and help the environment!
Thanks,
Martin Lee

questions.analysis: Why was this email written? 文中说：We need 50 student volunteers to help clean Riverside Park → 目的是招募清洁活动志愿者，选 B
What do volunteers receive? 文中明确写： Community service hours Free lunch A commemorative t-shirt 选项里只有 B. Community service hours 出现，选 B
When is the clean-up event? 第一句：participate in the annual City Clean-Up Day on May 5th → 时间是 May 5th，选 B
